## prompt-3-full-protocol

*Generated by Process A from the master prompt in
[`../prompts/prompt-protocol.md`](../prompts/prompt-protocol.md), adapting the
Phase I `trial-protocol` full stage to the Phase II protocol. Runs in stage
`trial-phase-2/full-protocol/`.*

Produce the **Stage 3 full protocol**: render every `[DRAFTING INSTRUCTION]` from
`../draft-protocol/` into complete prose, with each Mermaid figure drawn as a TikZ
`mermaidfig` and every table filled at the body measure, into
`trial-phase-2/full-protocol/`.

**Method.** Use the files the draft identified: the Phase I
`final-protocol/publication/sections/*` as the structural model, the
`trial-phase-2/mermaid/` figures as the figure source, the
`trial-protocol/inputs/2030-pdac-1min-final-paper` quantitative tables, the
`trial-protocol/inputs/21cfr312_adapt` Physical AI overlay, and the
`trial-protocol/inputs/auto-bill-02` VVUQ and financial framing. Optimize column
widths for aesthetics based on the amount of text per column. Verify twice that
each figure has (a) no text-box or arrow overlaps, (b) curved arrows with the
correct looseness, and (c) proper spacing between boxes. The LaTeX figures must
carry the same complexity and completeness as the Mermaid sources.

**Content (Phase II, in full).** Every NIH section addressed; the multicenter
randomized 1:1 controlled design (n = 220, eight sites, BICR); the experimental
arm (perioperative daraxonrasib at the RP2D plus the LLM-directed eight-arm
robotic Whipple) and the control arm (modified FOLFIRINOX plus standard
pancreaticoduodenectomy); the confirmatory PFS primary endpoint and the
fixed-sequence key secondary hierarchy; the upgraded Phase 0 readiness gate and
the full hard cyber-physical safety envelope; the four counterfactual scenarios;
the nine Physical AI concerns and mitigations; the Patient-Aligned Co-Investment
Facility and the capital firewall; the full statistical, safety, and oversight
machinery; and the back matter. The permitted media are full-width tables,
centered ASCII, and TikZ `mermaidfig`, each used only where it is the correct
representation. No images; white background; Burgundy `#800020` document color.

**Files and commit schedule.** One commit each for `main.tex`, `protostyle.sty`,
`references.bib`, and `README.md`; one commit per `sections/*.tex`. File
`prompt-full-protocol.md` (this prompt verbatim) and `output-full-protocol.md`.
Push every commit in real time (10+ commits). The second-to-last commit fixes all
errors across all files; the last commit writes the `full-protocol/README.md` and
the `full-protocol-LaTeX.zip` Overleaf bundle. Do not stall, ask questions, or go
into plan mode. The LaTeX must compile in Overleaf with pdfLaTeX.
